pkg.removed.description: Ensure a system package is not installed.

name.description: package to remove (defaults to the state ID)

service.dead.description: Ensure a service is stopped, optionally disabling it at boot.

enable.description: boot-enablement intent: enable:false also disables the unit; unset or true leaves it alone

name.description: service unit name (defaults to the state ID)

service.running.description: Ensure a service is running, optionally managing its boot enablement.

enable.description: boot-enablement intent: unset leaves it alone, true enables, false disables

name.description: service unit name (defaults to the state ID)

TriState.description: A three-valued boolean: unset, true, or false. Accepts a bool; the truthy/falsy string set (true/yes/1/on, false/no/0/off, case-insensitive); or an integer, where 1 is declared-true and 0 is declared-false — any other integer (for example 2) is a typed error, never silently ignored. The unset state lets a module tell "not specified" apart from an explicit false.

description: A Zester state file (state ID -> exactly one module name -> parameters), generated from each module's self-documenting schema (keystone spec). Only migrated modules are constrained via $defs.modules; a module absent from it has no schema yet and is left unconstrained.
title: Zester module parameters
